it is possible to identify the distribution zones within a water distribution network by using a tracer study, that it is possible, using the hydraulic model, to predict the residual chlorine concentrations in the network, and that it is possible with the water quality model to predict concentrations of chlorine at the dead-end of the network and to propose hydraulic strategies that will improve water quality at these dead-ends.

the proposed methodology is a useful and efficient tool to identify water distribution zones within drinking water distribution networks.
